name: BackToTop
replacement: native anchor link with CSS scroll-behavior
deprecation_reason: A page-local back-to-top control does not need an island or Shopify integration.
usage_hint: Compatibility contract for existing pages. Do not author this retired island in new source.
when_to_use: Inspect an existing page only; use the replacement in workflows/island-selection-workflow.md for new source.
when_not_to_use: Do not use for new page authoring.
anti_patterns: Setting threshold too low (<400px) — button appears before user needs it
Using on pages with sticky sidebars that occupy bottom-right (z-index conflicts)
Multiple BackToTop instances — only one is needed per page
